from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One document from the collection, capturing its title and which other works it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cited_works: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other works referenced in the bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
